# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 101 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 51 | Coptic

---

## Saying 101

**1** Jesus said: "Anyone who doesn't hate their father and mother the way I do cannot be my disciple. And anyone who doesn't love their father and mother the way I do cannot be my disciple. For my earthly mother gave me death, but my true mother gave me life."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "The way I do" — the manner of Jesus's own relationship to his parents
- "My earthly mother" — adds the adjective to distinguish from the true/divine mother
- The paradox (hate/love both required in Jesus's way) is made more accessible
